# Auto-generated rule: agents/*.md description frontmatter must be inline string, not YAML block scalar (>)

validate-plugin Check 11 explicitly rejects YAML block scalars in agent description fields. A multi-line description using > or | will fail validation: "description must be an inline string, not a YAML block scalar (got: ...)". Inline form (description: Long text on one line.) is required. Caught in W4 Q1 Full Gate for agents/dialectic-deriver.md when I1 used the block-scalar form. Workaround for long descriptions: just write a single long line — JSON schema allows it.

## Evidence
2026-05-23 deep-2 W4 Q1: validate-plugin reported "FAIL: dialectic-deriver.md: description must be an inline string, not a YAML block scalar (got: '>)" which cascaded into 15 test failures across persona-reviewers + orchestrators-e2e + check-agents + sandbox-tier + validate-plugin + ux-evaluator-frontmatter test suites (all of which run validate-plugin against the real repo). Fix: rewrite as inline string. Re-run: 101/0.

## Extension Review (2026-08-17)

Extended `expires-at` 2026-08-21 → 2026-11-19 (+90d, the `anti-pattern` TTL from
`LEARNING_TYPE_REGISTRY` in `scripts/lib/learnings/schema.mjs`).

The rejection is still live, so the trap is still live. `scripts/lib/agent-frontmatter.mjs:152`
still emits *"description must be an inline single-line string, not a YAML block scalar
(> or |). Put `<example>` blocks inline."* — a hard validation failure, and the failure mode
recorded above is that it cascades into ~15 test failures because several suites run
validate-plugin against the real repo rather than a fixture.

One correction to the rule text, made here rather than by editing the body: the check is no
longer *only* "Check 11" of a monolithic validate-plugin — the logic now lives in
`scripts/lib/agent-frontmatter.mjs`, with a second consumer in
`scripts/lib/description-surface.mjs` that folds block-scalar continuation lines when
measuring description size. The prohibition is unchanged; only its address moved. Anyone
grepping for "Check 11" and finding nothing should look at `agent-frontmatter.mjs` instead.
